subsystem.name: JpegPngImageDecoding
subsystem.responsibility: Image decoding over callback-driven byte streams: JPEG marker parsing and state-dispatch, JPEG APP-marker dispatch-table setup, PNG chunk parsing, IDAT row decompression/filtering, pass-aware post-processing, pixel-format conversion, plus shared guarded-dispatch (setjmp/longjmp) and format-table string infrastructure.

summary: DERIVED reconstruction of an image/JPEG/PNG decoding subsystem. The JPEG side is a stream decoder context (JpegStreamDecoder) that keeps a current marker byte at this+0x178, a callback-refilled byte-stream read-state at this+0x14, a 92-byte per-marker APP dispatch table at this+0x190, and a pointer to a state-dispatched object (StateDispatcher) reached through this+0x0. Seven functions implement marker reading (segment size, byte-stuffed bitstream tokens, SOI validation), the main marker dispatch loop, restart-marker handling, marker classification, and APP-table allocation/initialization. The PNG/row side is a second context (ImageDecodeContext) that parses PNG chunks (signature, chunk-type dispatch, IDAT termination, chunk-state validation), inflates and filters rows, runs pass-aware Huffman post-decoding and an optional callback. A separate FormatStateManager object carries a five-slot vtable, a stored format index plus eight stored format arguments, an access limit/counter pair, and a primary/alternate format-string table range; it is installed by sub_51177C. GuardedCallWithLongjmp is a shared setjmp/longjmp recovery trampoline reused by 15 callers. Owner identities of all these contexts are UNKNOWN at the C++ level; class boundaries here are DERIVED from overlapping offsets and shared callers, with uncertain objects kept in unresolved.

function_roles.role: Reads a 2-byte big-endian segment size from the stream, parameterized-dispatches state 90 via the dispatcher, and skips the remaining segment bytes; installed as APP-table slot 3 handler.

Shared bitstream marker reader: consumes bytes with 0xFF byte-stuffing (0xFF 0x00 escapes, consecutive 0xFF skipped) until a marker byte, accumulating a byte counter at this+0x1E8 and dispatching state 112 through the dispatcher.
Reads and validates the JPEG SOI marker (0xFF 0xD8); on mismatch dispatches error state 52 with the two unexpected bytes; stores the second byte as the current marker at this+0x178.

Main JPEG marker dispatch loop mapping the current marker at this+0x178 to decoder states (59/67/84/91 via dispatcher vfuncs) or to per-marker handlers (APP table at this+0x190, COM handler at this+0x19C); resets the marker slot after each dispatch.

Matches the current marker against the expected restart marker ((this+0x190 value)+84 plus 208), dispatching state 97 with the counter value and incrementing the counter modulo 8; delegates mismatches to an alternative stream-object handler.

Marker classification loop relative to a reference counter: drives decoder states 117 (init) and 96 (per-iteration) through the dispatcher, classifying the marker into expected/skip/acceptable categories and re-reading via the bitstream marker reader on skip.

Allocates a 92-byte JPEG APP-marker dispatch table via the allocator vfunc at this+0x4, stores it at this+0x190, fills slots (StateReset, CommandDispatchStateMachine, restart-marker, segment-size reader, defaults, APP0/APP14 overrides), then calls StateReset; called from sub_50F632.

FormatStateManager vfunc slot 1: resource access/release gated by the limit at obj+0x68 and the concurrent count at obj+0x6C, invoking the release callback at obj+0x8 on the indexed or unconditional path.

FormatStateManager vfunc slot 3: selects a format string by index from the primary/alternate format tables, falls back to the first primary string, and forwards stored arguments to StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x58815F) using varargs or va_list form based on a '%s' scan.
FormatStateManager vfunc slot 4: partial state reset clearing the format index (obj+0x14) and the concurrent access counter (obj+0x6C) on the struct reached through the a1 handle.

FormatStateManager installer/constructor: fills the five-slot vtable (ArithmeticComparison_166b, ReferenceCountedResourceAccessRelease, VtableDispatchThunk, FormatStringWithArgs, ResettableStateClear), sets the primary format table base (off_5ADE98) and count (119), and clears state slots; called by ImageTextureDecompressor (0x501722).
Sets three receiver fields from three parameters with remapping (a2 to this+0x48, a3 to this+0x40, a4 to this+0x44), returning the receiver pointer.

Shared guarded callback dispatch trampoline: loads the callback at a1+0x40, invokes it with (a1,a2) when non-null, unwinds through LongjmpMSVCCRT (0x58A770), then dispatches to CallbackDispatch as the return value; reused by 15 callers across stream and buffer code.
Two-stage buffer/context init: calls sub_5117C8(a1,a2) then GuardedCallWithLongjmp(a1, v3) with a local 80-byte longjmp scratch buffer, propagating the guarded-call result.

PNG chunk parser: validates the 8-byte signature (fetching missing bytes via CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard, comparing with BoundedMemcmpAgainstReference), iterates 4-byte chunk lengths/types dispatching IHDR/PLTE/IEND/gAMA/sRGB/tRNS/unknown to per-chunk handlers, terminates on IDAT, validates chunk-state flags (indexed color requires PLTE before IDAT), and records the IDAT size; longjmp error reporting for signature/PLTE/IHDR violations.

Image row decode: refills IDAT chunks, inflates rows via sub_517ADC, verifies stream completion, copies pixel-format bytes, computes row geometry, unpacks/filters the row, runs optional post-processing and pass-aware horizontal stretch plus a2/a3 Huffman decode passes, finalizes via sub_519019, and invokes an optional callback at this+0x16C; pass index (this+0x114) drives a 7-way switch.

Selects 1 (single mode) or 7 (multi-session selector) from the byte flag at this+0x113, OR-setting bit 2 of the flags DWORD at this+0x60 for the multi path. Shares offsets 0x113/0x60 with the row-decode pass logic; ownership tentatively assigned to ImageDecodeContext.

Stores two double camera-rotation parameters as floats (a3 to this+0x130, a2 to this+0x134) and raises bit 5 of the flags byte at this+0x61 when the product deviates from 1.0 by more than 0.05; called from sub_50210E.

Pixel bit-depth down-conversion (2/4/8/16 bpp) driven by a parameter block (count, buffer size, mode byte, input bit depth) and a per-channel shift lookup table; skips conversion when the mode byte is 3; called by sub_51389E.

Two-phase bit-packed indexed texture decoder: phase 1 (guarded on this+0x8 == 3) unpacks 4/2/1-bit planar fields to one byte per pixel and sets this+0x9 = 8; phase 2 (guarded on this+0x9 == 8) looks bytes up in an RGB palette with optional alpha table, recording output format in this+0x8/0xA/0xB and byte count in this+0x4; called by sub_51389E.

Configures a data-read callback: stores the user-data pointer (this+0x54) and read callback (this+0x50); if a write callback was already present at this+0x4C it is cleared and a conflict is reported through CallbackDispatch (0x511887); clears this+0x120 and returns the read callback.

classes.name: JpegStreamDecoder
classes.responsibility: JPEG/bitstream stream decoder context. Holds the current marker byte (this+0x178), the callback-refilled byte-stream read-state (this+0x14), the 92-byte per-marker APP dispatch table plus decoder config (this+0x190), the COM handler pointer (this+0x19C), and the state-dispatcher pointer (this+0x0). Marker reading, SOI validation, restart handling, marker dispatch and APP-table setup operate on this object. The concrete C++ type is unknown; ownership is DERIVED from overlapping offsets across the seven functions.

classes.name: StateDispatcher
classes.responsibility: State-dispatched call object reached through the decoder's this+0x0. Receives (state code, arg1, arg2) at obj+0x14/0x18/0x1C and dispatches through vfunc slot 0 (obj+0x0, error/state dispatch) or slot 1 (obj+0x4, parameterized dispatch). Observed state codes: 52, 59, 67, 84, 90, 91, 96, 97, 112, 117. Vfunc targets are caller-supplied and unresolved.

classes.name: ByteStreamReadState
classes.responsibility: Callback-refilled byte stream read-state pointed to by the decoder's this+0x14. Packet prose: word 0 = current read pointer, word 1 = remaining byte count, word 3 = refill callback, plus 16 = skip callback. Only offset 0x0 has a formal field evidence ref in this packet; the remaining words are unresolved.

classes.name: JpegAppDispatchTable
classes.responsibility: 92-byte per-marker dispatch table stored at this+0x190, allocated and filled by JpegAppDispatchTableInit. Slot 0 = StateReset, slot 1 = CommandDispatchStateMachine, slot 2 = restart-marker handler, slot 3 = segment-size reader, slots 4..18 default to StreamingDataReader with slot 4 (APP0) overridden to JPEGMarkerParsing and slot 18 (APP14) to AdobePSDHeaderParser. The table tail also holds decoder config: +0x50 byte-stuffing flag, +0x54 restart counter, +0x58 byte counter (accessed on the outer object as this+0x1E0/0x1E4/0x1E8).

classes.name: FormatStateManager
classes.responsibility: Format-string manager object installed by sub_51177C. Five-slot vtable (slots 0..4: ArithmeticComparison_166b, ReferenceCountedResourceAccessRelease, VtableDispatchThunk, FormatStringWithArgs, ResettableStateClear), a stored format index (obj+0x14), eight stored format arguments (obj+0x18..0x34), an access limit/counter pair (obj+0x68/0x6C) used by the resource access/release vfunc, and a primary/alternate format-table range (base obj+0x70, count obj+0x74, alternate start obj+0x78, alternate base obj+0x7C, alternate end obj+0x80). Reached through a pointer-to-pointer handle in 0x116A3/0x116D4/0x1176B (the struct is 'this' in the installer 0x1177C).

classes.name: GuardedCallbackContext
classes.responsibility: Context holding a guarded callback at this+0x40 invoked under setjmp/longjmp recovery (GuardedCallWithLongjmp) before delegation to a common dispatcher. TripleFieldSetter writes the 0x40/0x44/0x48 slot group; DoubleBufferInit runs a first init stage then the guarded call on the same a1. The trampoline is shared by 15 callers across stream/buffer code, so a single owner type is not established.

classes.name: ImageDecodeContext
classes.responsibility: Image/PNG decode context: PNG chunk parsing, IDAT-chunk row decompression, filtering and pass-aware post-processing. Flag words at this+0x58 (chunk-state flags: IHDR bit0, PLTE bit1, IDAT bit2), 0x5C and 0x60 gate chunk-state validation and decode passes; chunk length at 0xFC and chunk-type tag at 0x10C drive the chunk loop; row buffers/geometry live at 0x64..0x11C; optional post-decode callback at 0x16C. FlagBasedSessionModeSelector shares offsets 0x113/0x60 and is tentatively owned here (GUESS).

classes.name: CameraRotationState
classes.responsibility: Holds two float camera-rotation parameters (this+0x130/0x134) and a flags byte (this+0x61) whose bit 5 records a non-unit rotation-product deviation. Kept as a separate object from ImageDecodeContext despite sharing caller 0x50210E; the invariant meaning is unresolved.

classes.name: PixelConversionParams
classes.responsibility: Parameter block for pixel bit-depth conversion (0x5126D9): *a1 element count, a1[1] buffer size, byte +8 mode byte (3 skips conversion; bit 1 planar vs interleaved; bit 2 extra fourth channel), byte +9 input bit depth. Destination buffer and per-channel shift table are passed separately.

classes.name: IndexedTextureDecodeState
classes.responsibility: Two-phase bit-packed indexed texture decode state (0x512E1A): phase marker at +0x8 (3 selects the unpack phase; output format code 6=RGBA / 2=RGB after phase 2), bit depth/state byte at +0x9 (4/2/1 unpacked to 8), output bytes-per-pixel at +0xA (4/3), output stride at +0xB (32/24), pixel count / output byte count at +0x4. Palette stride (2 bytes per index) is inferred from address arithmetic.

classes.name: DataCallbackContext
classes.responsibility: Structure with a read-data callback (this+0x50) plus user-data pointer (this+0x54) and an optional write callback (this+0x4C); read/write callback coexistence is rejected via CallbackDispatch. A state field at this+0x120 is cleared on configuration. Owner type unknown; callers are 0x50210E and 0x5118E6.

state_machines.name: JpegMarkerDispatchLoop
states: idle: marker slot this+0x178 zero, read next marker
reading: marker read via bitstream marker reader or SOI marker reader
dispatching: branch on marker value
error_dispatch: state codes 59/67 via dispatcher vfunc slot 0
parameterized_dispatch: state codes 84/91 via dispatcher vfunc slot 1
app_table_dispatch: markers 224..239 via table at this+0x190, 254 via this+0x19C
per_marker: markers 192..204/219/220/221 to decoder handlers
transitions: marker slot reset to 0 after every dispatch forces a new read
reader return 0 aborts the loop with 0
unrecognized markers fall to error dispatch state 67

state_machines.name: RestartMarkerCounter
states: expect_next_restart: marker expected at counter+208
matched: dispatch state 97 with counter, clear marker, increment (c+1)&7
mismatch: delegate to alternative stream-object handler
unreadable: no marker and handler rejects, return 0
transitions: match -> counter increment modulo 8 and return 1
alternative handler acceptance -> same counter increment and return 1

state_machines.name: MarkerClassificationLoop
states: init: state 117 dispatched with current marker
classify: category 1 expected-marker / 2 skip / 3 acceptable-stop
per_iteration: state 96 dispatched with marker and category
transitions: category 2 -> read next marker via bitstream reader, repeat; reader fail -> return 0

state_machines.name: PngChunkParseLoop
states: signature_validate: consume up to 8 signature bytes, compare via bounded memcmp
read_length: fetch 4-byte chunk length, decode to int
read_type: copy 4-byte chunk-type tag to this+0x10C
dispatch: per-chunk handler for IHDR/PLTE/IEND/gAMA/sRGB/tRNS/unknown
idat_terminal: IDAT terminates the loop
post_validate: chunk-state flags check (indexed color requires PLTE before IDAT)
transitions: signature mismatch -> longjmp error path with 'Not a PNG file'/'PNG corrupted' strings
post_validate failure -> longjmp 'Missing PLTE/IHDR before IDAT'
success -> set flag bit 2, record IDAT length, return flags

interfaces.name: DispatchStateMachine
interfaces.purpose: Parameterized state dispatch through the dispatcher object: write (state code, arg1, arg2) to obj+0x14/0x18/0x1C, then call vfunc slot 0 (obj+0x0) or slot 1 (obj+0x4) with a mode argument. Used by all JPEG marker readers and the dispatch loop.

interfaces.name: LongjmpGuardedDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Guard a callback invocation with a saved setjmp/longjmp frame so decode failures unwind to a recovery point before a common dispatcher handles the result. Shared by 15 callers across stream and buffer code.

interfaces.name: PixelFormatConverter
interfaces.purpose: Convert stored pixel data to a target bit depth or color format: bit-depth down-conversion of byte streams and two-phase bit-packed indexed to RGB/RGBA decoding. Both entry points are called from sub_51389E.

compatibility_contracts.name: JpegMarkerStateCodes
compatibility_contracts.description: The dispatcher object carries (state code, arg1, arg2) at obj+0x14/0x18/0x1C and a two-slot vtable (obj+0x0 error/state dispatch, obj+0x4 parameterized dispatch). Observed state codes: 52 (SOI mismatch), 59/67 (error markers), 84 (marker 217), 90 (segment size read), 91 (markers 1/208..215), 97 (restart marker match), 112 (bitstream marker found), 117/96 (decode-loop init/per-iteration). A replacement must preserve this state-code protocol.

compatibility_contracts.name: JpegMarkerByteStuffing
compatibility_contracts.description: The bitstream marker reader treats 0xFF 0x00 as one escaped data byte, skips consecutive 0xFF bytes, and terminates on 0xFF followed by a non-zero non-0xFF marker byte. The accumulated byte counter at this+0x1E8 increases by 1 per ordinary data byte and by 2 per escape. The byte-stuffing flag lives at this+0x1E0.

compatibility_contracts.name: PngChunkStateValidation
compatibility_contracts.description: Chunk-state flags at this+0x58 track IHDR (bit 0), PLTE (bit 1) and IDAT (bit 2). Indexed color (color type 3 at this+0x116) requires PLTE before IDAT; violations are reported through the longjmp error path with the 'Missing PLTE before IDAT' (0x5AF318) / 'Missing IHDR before IDAT' (0x5AF334) strings. On success flag bit 2 is set and the IDAT length is stored at this+0xFC.

compatibility_contracts.name: LongjmpErrorReporting
compatibility_contracts.description: Fatal signature/decode errors propagate through GuardedCallWithLongjmp (0x511869) with a saved setjmp/longjmp frame. Observed error strings: 'Not a PNG file' (0x5AF350), 'PNG file corrupted by ASCII conversion' (0x5AF378), 'Extra compressed data' (0x5AF388), 'Decompression error' (0x5AF3A0), 'Not enough image data' (0x5AF3B4), invalid-attempt (0x5AF3CC). A replacement must keep this recoverable error path.

compatibility_contracts.name: PngChunkTagDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: The 4-byte chunk-type tag at this+0x10C is dispatched by tag constant: IHDR (0x5AF264), PLTE (0x5AF27C), IEND (0x5AF274), gAMA (0x5AF284), sRGB (0x5AF28C), tRNS (0x5AF294) to per-chunk handlers; IDAT (0x5AF26C) terminates the chunk loop; unknown tags go to a generic handler. A replacement must reproduce this tag routing.

compatibility_contracts.name: FormatTableSelection
compatibility_contracts.description: FormatStateManager selects a format string by index from a primary table (base obj+0x70, count obj+0x74) or an alternate range (start obj+0x78, base obj+0x7C, end obj+0x80); a null resolved pointer falls back to the first primary-table string, overriding the stored index argument. A '%s' sequence in the format selects the va_list call form; otherwise the varargs form is used, both reaching StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x58815F).

compatibility_contracts.name: StreamRefillCallbackContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The stream read-state at this+0x14 has word 0 = current read pointer and word 1 = remaining byte count (formal refs only for word 0); prose adds word 3 = refill callback and plus-16 = skip callback. A refill callback returning false aborts the read with return 0. The marker readers and segment-size reader depend on this contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: ReadWriteCallbackExclusion
compatibility_contracts.description: A callback structure may hold either a read callback (this+0x50, with user-data at this+0x54) or a write callback (this+0x4C), not both. Setting a read-data callback while a write callback is present clears the write slot and reports the conflict through CallbackDispatch (0x511887) with the string fragments 0x5AF4EC and 0x5AF520; this+0x120 is cleared and the read callback is returned.

compatibility_contracts.name: ImageDecodePassLookup
compatibility_contracts.description: The pass index (this+0x114) drives a 7-way switch of bitmask/threshold checks against this+0xD4 and this+0xB8 and selects per-pass Huffman decode via the lookup tables dword_5AF22C / dword_5AF248 with constants 15/51/85/255. Pass-aware post-decode runs TextureHorizontalStretch then two JPEGHuffmanDecoder passes. The pass semantics (Adam7 interlacing vs per-frame passes) are unresolved.
